_comment: Hard ceilings in BYTES for shipped artifacts, checked by scripts/check-size.mjs (warn locally, --strict in CI). Baselines and the ratchet discipline live in docs/perf-budget.md 'Size budget'. Ratchet DOWN as levers land; every INCREASE must be a deliberate, reviewed diff of this file. bootJsBytes = the entry chunk PLUS every chunk dist/index.html modulepreloads (the full static boot path; ratcheted 2026-08-17 to 1,040,000 after the A0 boot reclamation took the last six unclaimed surfaces lazy (BrowserPane, MemoryInspector, BookshelfView, OnboardingTour, SessionSidebar, FileViewer) with a boot-time landing-surface prefetch covering the doors — measured 1,010,988 B, ~29 KB headroom. Was 1,175,000 after MemorySurface went lazy 2026-08-14 — that lever paid for the Drafter's launch island, its blank page and the shared overlay mechanism, and the measured total AFTER all of it is 1,147,796 B, so ~27 KB of headroom remains. Was 1,210,000 with the path sitting at 99.1%). distTotalBytes ratcheted 2026-08-06 after the viewer folded into the main build (actual 7.71 MB, dist-viewer retired). binaryBytes ratcheted 2026-08-06 after the first post-profile release build (strip/thin-LTO/1cgu + the slimmer embedded dist: actual 25.66 MB, was 30.04 MB pre-profile).
